text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first leg of the Triple Tiara, the Oka Sho.
A race surrounded by the scent of cherry blossoms.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl must be fired up.
As I walked under the cherry blossom trees on my way to the racetrack...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Trainer... I...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You're running in the Oka Sho, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as I was wondering what on earth she was going to bring up on the day of the race...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"It's not that I've had a change of heart.
It's just..."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
What is this strange sensation...?
I had a feeling it somehow wouldn't come out.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You're still going to enter, though, aren't you...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—She seemed to sense a slight discomfort.
However, she couldn't tell
what was causing it.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Okay, understood!
Time to show everyone what I'm really capable of.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She wasn't acting like herself.
I couldn't help but feel a little worried, but...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, there's something I want to confirm
in this "Oka Sho"! Yes, and that is...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "My best distance! As I draw closer to my ideal form, I want to find out what distance truly suits me best!"
choice_data_list: Mile's a strong contender, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Of course! 1600m is no problem at all.
That is precisely why—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If your compatibility with this track is too good,
the second leg of the Triple Tiara
might not suit you.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The Yushun Himba (Oaks)—2400 meters.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl was right.
1,600 meters and 2,400 meters are two completely different beasts.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If she's this well-suited for the Oka Sho,
we might need to reconsider her next race."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's go. To discover my potential.
And—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Which path will the future connect to?
I'm going to seize that answer with my own hands!"
